inputs.resume_text:
VIKRAM SINGH RATHORE
PGP 2025-27, Indian Institute of Management Indore | vikram.rathore@iimidr.ac.in

EDUCATION
PGP, IIM Indore, 2025-27, CGPA 7.4/10 (Term 1-3)
B.Tech, Mechanical Engineering, Military College of Electronics and Mechanical Engineering (JNU), 2017, 7.9/10

WORK EXPERIENCE (60 months)
Indian Army, Corps of EME, Captain | Jun 2018 - May 2023
- Commanded a 120-member Light Repair Workshop supporting an armoured regiment in Rajasthan
- Cut average vehicle turnaround time from 9 days to 5 days by redesigning the spares indent cycle and setting up a forward spares cell
- Managed spares inventory worth INR 14 crore across 3 depots; brought audit discrepancies down to zero in two consecutive annual audits
- Led recovery of 22 vehicles during a flash flood exercise in Barmer with no casualties
Indian Army, Lieutenant | Jun 2017 - May 2018
- Officer-in-charge of a training cadre of 40 craftsmen
Career note: Jun 2023 - Jun 2025, prepared for CAT and worked as a volunteer instructor at a veterans' skilling centre in Jaipur

SUMMER INTERNSHIP
Tata Steel, Kalinganagar | Operations Intern | Apr - Jun 2026
- Built a criticality-based spares stocking model for 312 hot strip mill spares; projected INR 3.2 crore reduction in inventory holding with no rise in breakdown risk
- Mapped the breakdown-to-repair process across 4 departments and proposed a single work-order queue; adopted for the cold rolling mill pilot
- Received Pre-Placement Interview (PPI)

POSITIONS OF RESPONSIBILITY
- Member, Operations Club (OpsCom), IIM Indore: organised Supply Chain Summit with 9 industry speakers
- Sports Secretary, Officers' Mess, 2021-22

ACHIEVEMENTS
- Chief of Army Staff Commendation Card, 2022
- National finalist, Mahindra War Room 2025 (top 8 of 1,100 teams)

concerns.detail: The candidate is moving from military engineering and operations into an MBA path focused on operations and supply chain.

plan.warmup_question: What have you been learning in your MBA recently?
plan.background_question: Walk me through your career so far, from the Indian Army through Tata Steel and your MBA.

slots.core_question: You've moved from the Indian Army into an MBA and operations and supply chain. What draws you to this field now?
slots.intent_private: Needs a reason for the move tied to the candidate's Army and Tata Steel experience and to the kind of operations and supply chain role they are pursuing.
likely_probes: Which part of your Army experience most shaped this direction?
What have you done during your MBA to explore operations and supply chain?
What would make this role a better fit than returning to a military engineering path?

slots.core_question: What were you trying to solve when you built the spares stocking model at Tata Steel?
slots.intent_private: Needs a specific account of the inventory problem, Vikram's own analytical decisions, how criticality was determined, and how the projected INR 3.2 crore reduction was measured without increasing breakdown risk.
likely_probes: What decision did you personally make in the stocking model?
What did you compare when setting criticality for the spares?
How did you calculate the projected INR 3.2 crore reduction?

slots.core_question: Tell me about a time you had to make an operational decision with incomplete information.
slots.intent_private: Needs a concrete example from the Army, Tata Steel, the MBA or another relevant setting showing the information available, the decision Vikram made, and how he judged the outcome.
likely_probes: What did you do first to clarify the situation?
What trade-off did you decide to accept?
What result told you the decision was working?

slots.core_question: How did the vehicle turnaround improvement come about in your Army workshop?
slots.intent_private: Needs a specific account of Vikram's role in redesigning the spares process, the operational change behind the reduction from 9 days to 5 days, and how the baseline and result were tracked.
likely_probes: Which decision did you personally make to change the spares indent cycle?
What did you decide against when setting up the forward spares cell?
How was the reduction from 9 days to 5 days measured?

plan.plan_notes: The plan prioritizes the relevant Tata Steel internship, then tests a quantified Army process-improvement claim and the candidate's analytical judgment. The move from military engineering to an MBA and civilian operations and supply chain is a clear switch, so motivation covers it once; there is no separate concern slot because no unexplained gap is present.
